HOWEVER, a Wayback-archived (2021-07-25) snapshot of Gazprom Proektirovanie's own St. Petersburg-branch 'realized projects' page -- itself cited by GEM's wiki page as its citation #1 -- describes a DIFFERENT, earlier-vintage project on what appears to be the SAME physical corridor and even the SAME 'Gryazovets - Volkhov' section name: 'Lupingi gazoprovoda "Gryazovets - Vyborg" s tsel'yu zamykaniya vtoroy nitki na uchastke "Gryazovets - Volkhov"' (loops of the pre-existing Gryazovets-Vyborg trunk, closing its second string on the Gryazovets-Volkhov SECTION) -- explicitly stated to be built 'v ramkakh rasshireniya... dlya obespecheniya podachi gaza v gazoprovod "Severnyy potok-2"' (as part of expanding the Unified Gas Supply System to feed gas into the Nord Stream 2 export pipeline), with design documentation completed Dec 2015 and a positive Glavgosexpertiza review Aug 2016. Russian Government Directive No.166-r (31.01.2017, read directly via rulaws.ru) further describes this loop object with diameter 1420mm and working pressure 9.8 MPa -- the SAME 1420mm diameter recorded for P2313, though this is not conclusive given 1420mm is Gazprom's standard large-trunk diameter used region-wide. CONCLUSION: this looks like a genuine multi-year corridor evolution -- a 2015-2017-planned Nord Stream 2 capacity loop on the same route/section name, whose actual on-the-ground construction (per every dated source found) did not visibly proceed under that NS2 framing, followed by the SAME general corridor being repurposed and built starting Jan 2022 for the newer Ust-Luga ethane-gas need -- rather than evidence that GEM has conflated two different objects into one row. No GEM citation for P2313 references the 2015-2017 decrees or a Nord Stream 2 purpose; all 12 describe only the 2022-onward ethane project. Filed as 'confirmed (caveat)' rather than a hard existence/duplicate/classification error, because the recorded project (P2313 itself) checks out -- the caveat is that a human reviewer should confirm GEM's wider tracker does not also carry a separate, now-superseded 'Gryazovets-Vyborg loop / NS2' entry that could be mistaken for the same object, or vice versa.

The sheet records PipelineType='distribution'. Per this batch's own stated classification test -- a row named '<X> - ГРС <Y>' is the отвод (branch/feeder), i.e. the UPSTREAM/transmission side terminating AT the gas-distribution station, not the downstream distribution network fed FROM that station -- this object's own name ('Газопровод-отвод и ГРС "Усть-Луга"', literally 'gas pipeline branch AND gas distribution station Ust-Luga') places it squarely on the transmission side of that boundary: it IS the отвод plus the ГРС itself, not the межпоселковый (intersettlement) distribution mains that lead away from the ГРС into individual settlements. Both primary sources reinforce this: the federal decree places it inside Russia's national pipeline-TRANSPORT planning scheme (not a municipal gasification/distribution programme document), and the Gazstroyprom tender registry groups it with GSP-numbered trunk/branch objects, not municipal межпоселковый distribution-network contracts. Per explicit batch instructions I am flagging this as a classification concern rather than unilaterally overriding the sheet value via a fill -- the PipelineType [ref] fill unit itself is staged UNRESOLVED (no source explicitly applies GEM's own 'distribution'/'transmission' vocabulary to this object), and the contested value here ('transmission') is offered as the researcher's recommended correction for human review, not an applied change.
